newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia needs to find more metals reserves - minister.
newsitem.headline: Russia needs to find more metals reserves - minister.

text.p: Russia needs to identify new metals reserves to match the depletion rate of its known resources, Natural Resources Minister Viktor Orlov said on Wednesday.
Orlov, quoted by Interfax news agency at a ministry meeting, said new nickel reserves discovered in 1996 were only 15 percent of that year's production.
The rate for copper was 18 percent, wolframite was 21 percent and tin was 28 percent. Lead and zinc were 37 percent.
Orlov said that since 1994 Russia had not spent enough on natural resource exploration.
He blamed a lack of government cash.
